findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "A language model reads the French report…" → 4 lines at 30.6px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Cresta ovest, neve dura" 3.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "Schöner Pulver im Wald" 3.9:1 needs 4.5:1; "Émis le vendredi 20 février à 16 h. Donn" 4.4:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Newsreader, Hanken Grotesk, Caveat).

findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "AlpenGuard" (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "Your route, on the real mountain" (screen 2, 100% over a picture); "Every slope over 30°, lit" (screen 3, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
